verdict_summary: Careful, well-sourced revision with no high-severity problems. No party labels, no minors named, no private addresses, no anticipated arguments. All six cards have the same seven fields. The two value lines are parallel and verbatim, with no recommendation words. All length budgets are met, though three items sit exactly at the limit: the 30-second version at 90 words with labels, value line 104 at 35, the Layer 3 intro at 60. Four medium fixes: (1) the Florida 'larger effects' ambiguity is flagged only for suspensions, the finding that would help opponents; (2) the printed labeling rule is silent on the legend's Mixed, Contested and Values question labels, while cards 2 and 5 contain conflicting accounts labeled Uncertain; (3) Adams's anecdote gets a specific caveat that Harrell's 'very successful' claim doesn't; (4) most tabs read at about grade 9.5-10 (rough Flesch-Kincaid), and line 21 is a 219-word bullet. The rest are low-severity parity, plain-language and precision fixes, such as the verbs 'worries' and 'police', the opponents' survey figure repeated in Options, the values-guide wording, Option C's missing cost, the governor entry's format and the stated purpose of the P-060 events.
